provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A Go service chmods a file to 0o777, making it world-writable.

groundTruth.rationale: Mode 0o777 lets any local account modify the file, so a config or script consumed later can be replaced.

limitations: Line-level lexical detection only; the rule is a review prompt, not proof of exploitability.
